create_dinat_image_classifier: create a DinatForImageClassification model for image classification with configurable number of labels
build_dinat_model: build a DinatModel with patch embeddings, encoder, and optional adaptive average pooling layer
run_dinat_backbone: run a DinatBackbone to extract multi-scale feature maps for downstream tasks like DETR or MaskFormer
test_neighborhood_attention: test the NeighborhoodAttention module that computes dilated neighborhood attention using NATTEN operations
summarize_dinat_encoder: summarize the DinatEncoder that stacks DinatStages with dilated neighborhood attention and downsampling layers
